title: Ivartin 2mg: Benefits, Ingredients, Dosage, and Side Effects
content_md: Note: This article is not written by a professional; please consult a medical expert before acting on any information. This article covers Ivartin 2mg, a medication prescribed for patients diagnosed with high cholesterol or hyperlipidemia. Ivartin 2mg contains Pitavastatin and belongs to the statin class of cholesterol-lowering drugs. It is indicated for the treatment of atherosclerosis. This is not cybersecurity content.
